title: 米軍、一部撤収のドイツは欧州最大の拠点　深まる欧米の亀裂
extracted_text: 米国とイスラエルの対イラン軍事作戦を巡って、欧米間の亀裂が一段と深まっている。米国防総省は1日、ドイツに駐留する米軍約5000人を削減すると発表した。駐独米軍の一部撤収表明は、作戦に距離を置く欧州の同盟国への「懲罰」的な意味合いが強い。米国防総省が欧州各国に兵器納入が大幅に遅れる可能性があると警告したとも報じられている。ロシアのウクライナ侵攻が続くなか、欧州の抑止力低下が懸念される事態になりつつある。 「大統領は当然の反応をしている」。ロイター通信によると、ある国防総省幹部はドイツのメルツ首相の対イラン軍事作戦への発言を「不適切で役に立たない」と表現し、駐独米軍の削減方針についてそう説明したという。 ただし、ドイツは米軍にとって欧州最大の拠点だ。作戦や部隊のローテーションによって異なるが、欧州に派遣されている米兵のおよそ半分にあたる3万5000～4万人が駐留。欧州軍とアフリカ軍の司令部や米国外では最大となる国防総省系の医療施設も設置されており、核兵器も配備されている。 実際に、米紙ニューヨーク・タイムズによると、イランの攻撃対象となった中東地域の基地の米兵らはドイツに避難した。負傷した米兵もドイツの医療施設に搬送されているという。一部撤収が実施されれば、…
translated_text: The rift between the West and the U.S. is deepening over the U.S.-Israel military operation against Iran. The U.S. Department of Defense announced on the 1st that it would reduce about 5,000 U.S. troops stationed in Germany. The announcement of partial withdrawal of U.S. troops in Germany appears to carry a "punitive" meaning toward European allies who are keeping distance from the operation. It has also been reported that the Pentagon warned European countries that arms deliveries could be significantly delayed. With Russia's invasion of Ukraine continuing, there is growing concern about the decline of Europe's deterrent capability. "The president is making a natural response." According to Reuters, a senior Pentagon official described Chancellor Scholz's remarks on the Iran military operation as "inappropriate and useless," explaining the troop reduction in this way. However, Germany is the largest U.S. base in Europe. Depending on operations and unit rotations, about 35,000 to 40,000 U.S. troops, roughly half of all U.S. soldiers deployed in Europe, are stationed there. The headquarters for U.S. European and African Commands are located there, as well as the largest Pentagon-run medical facility outside the United States, and nuclear weapons are also deployed. In fact, according to the New York Times, U.S. soldiers at bases in the Middle East that were targeted by Iran evacuated to Germany. Wounded U.S. soldiers have also been transported to medical facilities in Germany. If the partial withdrawal is implemented...
title_en: Germany Remains Largest U.S. Base in Europe Amid Growing Transatlantic Rift
